cases.sentence: Ависсалом завел себе колесницу, лошадей и свиту из пятидесяти ___.
cases.translation: Absalom prepared for himself a chariot and horses and a retinue of fifty men.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used as the object of the number пятидесяти in the plural.

cases.sentence: Он вставал рано утром и становился у обочины дороги, которая вела к городским ___.
cases.translation: He rose early and stood beside the way that led to the city gates.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) indicating direction takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Всякий раз, когда кто-нибудь шел с жалобой на суд к царю, Авесолом подзывал его и спрашивал о его ___.
cases.translation: Whenever someone came with a dispute for the king to judge, Absalom called to him and asked about his case.
cases.explain: The preposition 'о' (about) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: И всякий раз, когда кто-нибудь подходил, чтобы поклониться ему, Ависсалом протягивал руку, обнимал его и целовал по ___.
cases.translation: Whenever anyone approached to pay him homage, Absalom would reach out, embrace him, and kiss him on the cheek.
cases.explain: The preposition по (on) indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Ависсалом сказал царю, «Позволь мне отправиться в Хеврон и исполнить клятву, которую я дал ___».
cases.translation: Absalom said to the king, 'Let me go to Hebron and fulfill the vow I made to the Lord.'
cases.explain: The verb 'давать клятву' (to make a vow) takes the dative case for the recipient.

cases.sentence: Вместе с Ависсаломом из Иерусалима пошли двести ___.
cases.translation: Two hundred men went with Absalom from Jerusalem.
cases.explain: After the number двести, the nominative plural of the noun is used.

cases.sentence: Ахитофел был советником ___, в его город Гило.
cases.translation: Ahithophel was David's counselor, from his city of Giloh.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession; 'советник Давида' means 'David's counselor'.

cases.sentence: К Давиду пришел вестник и сказал ему, «Сердца израилетян на стороне ___».
cases.translation: A messenger came to David and told him, 'The hearts of the men of Israel are with Absalom.'
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with 'на стороне' (on the side of) to indicate allegiance.

reading.ru: После этого Ависсалом завел себе колесницу, лошадей и свиту из пятидесяти человек, чтобы бежали перед ним.
reading.question: How did Absalom present himself after his return to Jerusalem?
options: With a chariot, horses, and a retinue of fifty men running before him
As a simple servant of his father
Leading a group of priests and judges
With soldiers to guard the city
reading.correct: With a chariot, horses, and a retinue of fifty men running before him
reading.explain: The text states: 'Ави ссалом завел себе колесницу, лошадей и свиту из пятидесяти человек' — Absalom prepared a chariot, horses, and a retinue of fifty men.

reading.ru: Всякий раз, когда кто-нибудь шел с жалобой на суд к царю, Авесолом подзывал его и спрашивал, «Из какого ты города?»
reading.question: What would Absalom do when someone came with a dispute for the king?
options: He would call to them and ask what city they were from
He would direct them to the king's court
He would refuse to help them
He would take them to his own home
reading.correct: He would call to them and ask what city they were from
reading.explain: The text says: 'Авесолом подзывал его и спрашивал, Из какого ты города' — Absalom would call to him and ask, 'What city are you from?'

reading.ru: И всякий раз, когда кто-нибудь подходил, чтобы поклониться ему, Ависсалом протягивал руку, обнимал его и целовал.
reading.question: How did Absalom treat people who came to pay him respect?
options: He would reach out his hand, embrace them, and kiss them
He would order them to leave
He would demand payment from them
reading.correct: He would reach out his hand, embrace them, and kiss them
reading.explain: The text states: 'Ави ссалом протягивал руку, обнимал его и целовал' — Absalom would stretch out his hand, embrace him, and kiss him.

reading.ru: Так Ависсалом вел себя со всеми израилетянами, которые приходили к царю в поисках справедливости, так он вкрадывался в сердца всех израилетян.
reading.question: What was Absalom's purpose in treating people this way?
options: He was stealing the hearts of all the Israelites
He was helping his father administer justice
He was testing the loyalty of the people
He was preparing them for war
reading.correct: He was stealing the hearts of all the Israelites
reading.explain: The text explicitly says: 'так он вкрадывался в сердца всех израилетян' — thus he stole the hearts of all the Israelites.

reading.ru: Ависсалом разослал тайных вестников по всем родам Израиля, чтобы сказать, «Как только вы услышите звук рогов, говорите, «Ави ссалом воцарился в Хевроне».
reading.question: What secret message did Absalom send throughout Israel?
options: When you hear the sound of the trumpet, say that Absalom is king in Hebron
That Absalom was going on a pilgrimage
That the king was coming to visit the cities
That there would be a great feast in Hebron
reading.correct: When you hear the sound of the trumpet, say that Absalom is king in Hebron
reading.explain: The text states: 'Как только вы услышите звук рогов, говорите, Ави ссалом воцарился в Хевроне' — As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, say, Absalom is king in Hebron.

reading.ru: К Давиду пришел вестник и сказал ему, «Сердца израилетян на стороне Авесолома».
reading.question: What did the messenger tell David?
options: The hearts of the Israelites were with Absalom
The people were loyal to David
Absalom was coming to make peace
reading.correct: The hearts of the Israelites were with Absalom
reading.explain: The messenger reported: 'Сердца израилетян на стороне Авесолома' — The hearts of the Israelites are with Absalom.
